parameters: My darling, let's go, your mommy is getting tired of walking.
my sweetie... you could give my paw a massage, you only do it to Zoe.
I know she's heavier, but that's unfair to your mommy here.
Heavier? What are you talking about?
Hehehe, my sweetie, you really didn't notice, did you...
well, you'll notice after a while.
It was your idea to come here now, wait.
I...know...but look at my size...I'm too big, I need food.
*sigh* Here, take this, I have this sweet treat
just to help you hold on a little longer.
Hehe, that's why I love you so much, my big boy, always
ready to take care of your little bear.
Look, there's a cave over there; it looks like a comfy place.
my little \n[1] I may be the most beautiful woman in the world, but I'm still a bear...
for you, I'm the most beautiful woman in the world, right?
Do you think this wood will be good enough?
Trust me, sweetie... have I ever done anything wrong?
Hehe, I'm always impressed to see how strong you are, my sweetie.♡♡
Thank you...you're the one who helped me get like this.
We could go fishing again someday.
The last time you were just my little boy.
I would like to, but I don't have time after we resolve the
problems we've created for us to go fishing again.
Great, we got enough, let's go home.
Sweetie, let's go to that cave and wait for the rain to pass.
I don't want to get my fur wet.
My sweetie, the sun is starting to set, we'd better go soon.
And judging by the clouds, it's definitely going to rain soon.
Look at this place, so clean it looks like it's been untouched.
How did you find this place?
My darling, I've been to practically every place... I traveled a lot with Elizabeth during the war.
now let's focus on gathering firewood for our barbecue. You see those thinner trees? They'll be useful.
About 6 will be enough, you cut and I'll carry.
